title: Separate Klipper saved items according to activities
line: The clipboard can now keep a separate history for each activity, so items copied in one activity no longer show up in another.
explanation: Klipper kept one history for the whole session, with no idea of which activity an item was copied in, so private items copied in one activity were listed (and pasteable) in every other activity. The change records the current activity of each item in the history database (a new nullable column, added on startup to existing databases) and adds an opt-in setting, "Keep a separate history for each activity", under Clipboard history. With it on, the popup, history cycling and Clear History only use the current activity's items, and switching activities reloads the history and puts that activity's latest item on the clipboard.

commits.message:
klipper: optionally keep a separate history for each activity

The clipboard history was shared by all activities, so text copied in a
private activity also showed up in a work one. A new opt-in setting
saves each item's activity and only shows the current activity's items.

BUG: 431140

media.caption: Master, in the Work activity: the note copied in the Default activity is listed too.
With the fix and the option on, the Work activity only shows what was copied in Work.
Master, back in Default: the Work snippet is listed and is on the clipboard.
With the fix, Default only shows its own note, and the clipboard switched to it.
Master's Clipboard settings: no per-activity option.
The new "Keep a separate history for each activity" option under Clipboard history.
